description: This file provides functions to resolve and ensure the presence of a 'pi' command executable, possibly downloading and installing it if necessary. It manages runtime paths and environmental configurations for invoking the 'pi' CLI tool within a Go project.

methods.name: resolveDocsPiCommand
methods.description: Resolves the 'pi' command to use, either from environment, system PATH, or by ensuring it is installed locally.

methods.name: shouldMaterializePiRuntime
methods.description: Determines whether the 'pi' runtime needs to be downloaded and installed based on its path.

methods.name: ensureMaterializedPiRuntime
methods.description: Ensures the local 'pi' runtime is available, installing it if necessary.

methods.name: getMaterializedPiRuntimeDir
methods.description: Returns the directory path where the local 'pi' runtime is installed.

methods.name: getMaterializedPiPackageVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version of the 'pi' package to be used.
